field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: The three mandated GGUF identities are explicit and cannot drift to legacy smoke models.
field_principles.answer_channel_ready_score: Readiness is a strict mechanical gate.
field_principles.control_manifest: Controls and expected answers are frozen before outcomes.
field_principles.cuda_device_receipts: NVIDIA devices and memory snapshots are preserved.
field_principles.cuda_offload_authenticated_score: The two-model CUDA gate scalar is mechanical.
field_principles.external_scorer_used: No external judge can decide labels.
field_principles.field_principles: Every gate field names the evidence boundary it protects.
field_principles.gpu_memory_before_mb: CPU fallback cannot hide as a baseline.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal state starts complete: or blocked:.
field_principles.llama_cpp_version: The Python runtime can be reconstructed.
field_principles.model_hashes: Weight bytes are bound to the artifact.
field_principles.n_gpu_layers_offloaded: Positive offload evidence is separate from intent.
field_principles.native_json_grammar_used: The retired grammar path stays closed.
field_principles.parse_failure_count: Parser failures remain separate from semantic errors.
field_principles.protocol_matrix: Completion/chat, stop policy, and budget arms are preregistered.
field_principles.qualified_model_ids: The qualifying mandated models are visible.
field_principles.qualified_protocol: The downstream answer channel is frozen only from controls.
field_principles.quantizations: Observed quantization is recorded per weight file.
field_principles.raw_response_manifest_path: Raw row evidence is lossless and replayable.
field_principles.resolved_model_receipts: Cache paths, file sizes, and local presence are auditable before inference.
field_principles.retired_runtime_used: Retired runtimes cannot qualify the channel.
field_principles.root_cause_attribution: Exp 5708 failure causes are reported explicitly.
field_principles.semantic_error_count: Exact wrong answers remain separate from parse errors.
